versions.changelog:
- Initial release of guaikei-kuaishou-video-comment-fetcher.
- Enables fast retrieval of Kuaishou (快手) public data for competitive research, content analysis, trend insights, and KOL monitoring.
- Supports three main features: keyword video search, creator content tracking, and video comment fetching.
- Requires only a valid GUAIKEI_API_TOKEN; no need for Kuaishou account login.
- Clear input rules, robust error handling, and JSON-structured results suitable for further analysis and reporting.
